artDirection: Colorful fantasy pixel art, angled isometric world (approved reference A); hard-edged single palette; nearest-neighbour scaling.

projection.rule: tile (x, y) north vertex at screen ((x - y) * 32, (x + y) * 16); actors stand at tile centres (x + 0.5, y + 0.5)

gladiator.notes: Draw layers in listed order with identical frame suffixes (layerId/action/dir/index). Draw one body (body, or body-female for a female body) with its clothes (cloth, or cloth-female) and at most one hair layer (hair is short; hair-long, hair-ponytail; none when bald). Multiply-tint layers by their tint key (skin, cloth, hair) per player. Two-handed weapons hide offhand-shield; head gear hides every hair layer; head-helmet-crest only with head-helmet; accent is always drawn.

depthRule: actors: depth = screen y of the feet. floor props: under all actors. foreground props: over all actors. props with explicit slices (arena wall segments): each slice draws its column range at anchor screen y + slice.depthOffset. other object props one tile wide: depth = anchor screen y + sortY - 0.5. wider object props: drawn as 32px vertical slices, each at the screen y of the footprint front edge under the slice centre - 0.5. The 0.5 bias means actors win ties. Implemented by drawSlices in src/game/depth.ts.

closeups.notes: Fighters stand on floor row groundY at fighterX (left faces se, right faces sw). Draw the backdrop, fighters and effects at the same integer scale so art pixels share one grid.
